method: 17 states as prior audit; fit pre2025, 2025 validation with 15d purge, H1 2026 test. Marginal smoothed effects averaged within each axis then ridge logistic combines four axes; missing contributes zero adjustment, not adverse. Threshold selected on validation >=10 alarms, prefer >=70% precision else best precision. Separate future pivot and forward 5d directional return >=3% from next open (not conditional on confirmed pivot). Daily observations not cooldown alarms; unique recall cohort Jan6-Jun30. No VPVR/liquidation. H1 previously inspected.
